title: introduce-rbac-bootstrap-orchestrator-and-helm-upgrade-hooks-for-private-deployments
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: Private deployments require deterministic tenant RBAC bootstrap and safe upgrades for on-prem/helm installs. This PR adds a new rbac-bootstrap-orchestrator utility, Helm post-install/upgrade hooks to run idempotent role/rolebinding reconciliation, and a Terraform module wrapper for tenant seeds to support drift detection and automated rollback markers. Changes: implement rbac-bootstrap-orchestrator (Go) with leader-election + dry-run mode, add helm hooks/templates in private-installer/chart/templates for post-install and pre-upgrade checks, introduce terraform/rbac-tenant-seed module with exported state marker and rollback resource, add end-to-end k8s e2e test harness that runs in CI with a kind cluster, and migration scripts to reconcile legacy role names to the new tenant-scoped roles. Security: orchestrator supports KMS-wrapped service account tokens for sensitive operations; RBAC changes gate execution to cluster-admin only when a new bootstrap marker is absent. Backwards compatibility: hooks are opt-in via chart value enableRbacBootstrap=true to avoid surprise changes during upgrades. Testing: unit tests for reconciliation logic, integration tests for helm hooks, and CI workflow added as .github/workflows/ci-rbac-bootstrap.yaml. Checklist: | - add rbac-bootstrap-orchestrator binary and CLI flags (leader-elect, dry-run, max-retries) | - helm templates and hooks with tests | - terraform module and example usage in infra/examples/private-tenant-seed | - migration script + idempotency guarantees | - CI job and smoke e2e in kind | - docs update in docs/private/rbac-bootstrapping.md | - release notes entry
commits: initial: add orchestrator main and reconcile loop
helm: add post-install and pre-upgrade hook templates
terraform: add rbac-tenant-seed module and example
tests: add e2e kind harness and smoke tests
docs: rbac bootstrapping guide and upgrade notes
fix: ensure leader-election backoff and metrics labels
review_thread: Diego Morales (reviewer): Can the orchestrator be instantiated as a sidecar? Concern about lifecycle during helm upgrade.

Aisha (author): Decided against sidecar to avoid coupling to application pods; orchestrator runs as a short-lived Job in the chart hooks for install/upgrade and as a Deployment for ongoing reconciliation when enabled.
Song Li (reviewer): Request: add more granular unit tests around role reconciliation failures and retry/backoff behavior.
Aisha: Added tests for transient API errors and exponential backoff; added metric rbac_reconcile_retries_total.
Priya Menon (security): Question: how do we ensure service account tokens are not exposed in logs?
Aisha: Orchestrator redacts tokens in logs, and we switched to referencing KMS-wrapped tokens via CSI so the raw secret never lands in pod envs; added docs section explaining KMS integration.
Diego: approval after requested changes addressed.
CI: workflow run passed on commit 6e4a3f — all checks green including unit/integration and e2e smoke.
release_notes: Private installer: add optional RBAC bootstrap orchestrator and Helm hooks to safely seed tenant-scoped roles; Terraform module for tenant seeding added. Opt-in behavior via chart value enableRbacBootstrap=true. Includes migration script for legacy roles and safe rollback markers. Improves idempotency and reduces manual ops during on-prem upgrades.
